nodes.name: helpers.bash
nodes.summary: Shared bats helpers for pact.sh tests providing setup_pact_repo (creates a throwaway git repo, copies pact.sh into place, sources it), log_lines (counts events in the log), and task_status (reads rendered STATE via grep).

nodes.name: setup_pact_repo
nodes.summary: Makes a throwaway git repo in BATS_TEST_TMPDIR/work, configures user.email/user.name, copies pact.sh into .pact/bin/pact.sh, commits a base, and sources pact.sh so every test starts in a clean, isolated state.

nodes.name: init.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for pact_init covering skeleton creation (PROJECT.md, log.jsonl, STATE.yml, tasks dir), init event payload shape, entry-file baking (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md with PACT_AGENT_ID + join command), STATE rendering, fail-closed without PACT_AGENT_ID, PROJECT.md Seats section, and 4-field seat wiring with MCP-kind validation rejecting kind mismatches and desktop kinds.

nodes.name: install_sh.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for install.sh covering detect_arch mapping (x86_64 to amd64, aarch64/arm64 to arm64), end-to-end install from a local download base with sha256 checksums, and checksum-mismatch rejection (installs nothing on bad checksums).

nodes.name: integration_sixstage.bats
nodes.summary: End-to-end bats coverage of the six-stage pact protocol flow init then assign then join then checkpoint then accept then merge, plus two exit-gate tests proving a worker cannot self-accept and a crash mid-task can be resumed by sourcing pact.sh and running log --replay.

nodes.name: interop.bats
nodes.summary: Interop bats tests proving bash pact.sh and the Go pactify CLI share the same protocol: bash init+assign then Go join/checkpoint/accept/merge (STATE byte-identical via diff) and the reverse direction Go init then bash continue, with both validate passing in both directions.

nodes.name: join.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for pact_join covering that join appends a join event to log.jsonl and that join fails closed without PACT_AGENT_ID set.

nodes.name: mcp_project.bats
nodes.summary: Bats test that `pactify mcp --project PATH` roots the MCP server at a project from a different cwd, proving the --project flag bypasses CWD lookup when answering the status tool call.

nodes.name: mcp.bats
nodes.summary: Bats test that `pactify mcp` answers initialize and lists the pact tools (pactify, checkpoint, merge) over stdio when driven by a piped JSON-RPC client guarded by a 10-second perl alarm timeout.

nodes.name: merge.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for pact_merge covering rule 2 (merge rejected when a task is not accepted) and the happy path: worker join auto-checks out the feature branch, checkpoint auto-commits work, reviewer accepts, merge auto-returns to base, STATE shows shipped, file arrives on base, and the merge commit is present in the log.

nodes.name: multiline_evidence.bats
nodes.summary: Regression bats tests for multi-line evidence (e.g. `go test -v` output) confirming STATE.yml evidence stays on a single line, pact_validate runs cleanly with no jq parse errors, and the rule-1 owner==reviewer check still fires under newlines.

nodes.name: plugin.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for the Claude plugin packaging: marketplace.json is valid and points at an existing plugin source, .mcp.json registers the pact server with bare `pactify mcp`, hooks.json is valid and points at an executable check-pactify.sh hook, and the hook exits 0 whether pactify is present or missing (with `install.sh | sh` install hint).

nodes.name: project_md.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for _pact_bake_project and PROJECT.md: shows protocol_version and seats, preserves user content outside the managed `pact:begin` block, and re-baking is byte-stable (no blank-line growth across multiple runs).

nodes.name: projection.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for _pact_project_json and _pact_render_state: project + seats are projected from the init event, join moves an owned assigned task to in_progress and checkpoint to awaiting_review (with evidence), and render_state writes a grep-readable STATE.yml.

nodes.name: protocol_v1.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for pact protocol v1 conformance: every event has a non-empty event_id, event_ids are unique, init carries protocol_version=1, PACT_PROTOCOL_VERSION is exposed as 1, validate passes on a conformant repo, validate fails when protocol_version exceeds supported, validate flags missing event_id, and forward-compat: unknown event_type is ignored by the projection plus log --replay still rebuilds STATE.

nodes.name: review_fixes.bats
nodes.summary: Regression bats tests for review-feedback fixes: C1 (accept/changes rejected on non-awaiting tasks), C2 (assign rejects duplicate task ids), I3 (merge rejects unknown feature), I4 (init rejects malformed seats with no partial state and rejects path-traversal entries), and a happy-path regression confirming validate stays clean after the fixes.

nodes.name: schemas.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for JSON schemas under schemas/: event/seat/task schema files are valid JSON, every emitted event in a full flow (init then assign then join then checkpoint then accept then merge) validates against event.schema.json via jsonschema, and the seat/task schemas are referenced by the event payload correctly.

nodes.name: serve_author.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for the serve authoring surface: pact-init two seats, register, serve on a free port with --seat claude-opus, then exercise the /api/acting-seat and author-only dashboard mutations (drop-target, drag-during-sse) while the mock server records what would have been authored.

nodes.name: serve_comms.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for the comms timeline and replay endpoints: scripted event sequence (init then CLI join opencode then API assign t1) feeds the /api/comms/* endpoints so the timeline/replay output has a known, ordered log to fold over.

nodes.name: serve_ops.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for ops wiring over the API/CLI with an empty registry and PACTIFY_HOME pointed at a temp dir: server boots with --seat claude-opus and an empty registry, then the flow registers the project plus wires plus joins entirely through HTTP/CLI without pre-registration.

nodes.name: serve.bats
nodes.summary: Smoke bats tests for the serve surface: register then serve exposes the project over HTTP (curl /api/projects returns the demo project), and serve renders the embedded dashboard at / with status 200 and `<div id="root">`.

nodes.name: skill.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for the .claude/skills/pact/SKILL.md file: frontmatter is present (--- + name: + description:), the skill points to .pact/PROJECT.md as the source of truth, and stays thin (no more than 60 lines) so the protocol lives in .pact/ rather than in the skill.

nodes.name: smoke.bats
nodes.summary: Single-test bats smoke confirming the harness works: temp repo + pact.sh sourcing succeeds and pact_init is declared (loaded) after sourcing.

nodes.name: spec_doc.bats
nodes.summary: Bats test for the pact protocol spec doc (docs/specs/pact-protocol.md): the file exists, covers protocol_version, event_id, all v1 event types (init, assign, join, checkpoint, accept, changes_requested, merge), the two rules (no self-accept, all-tasks-accepted before merge), awaiting_review, seats, forward-compat (unknown fields), and references schemas/event.schema.json.

nodes.name: status_validate.bats
nodes.summary: Bats tests for pact_status and pact_validate: status prints the current STATE, log --replay rebuilds STATE identically (projection invariant), validate passes on a consistent repo, validate fails when STATE is hand-edited (drift), and validate fails when a log agent_id is not a declared seat.

nodes.name: fixtures.mjs
nodes.summary: Hermetic JSON fixtures for the dashboard e2e mock server: shapes byte-for-byte match the real serve JSON (registry, projects, fs browse, setup suggest/apply, acting-seat) plus a mutable initialState with one feature f1 and two tasks (t1 in_progress, t2 assigned deps=[t1]) and helpers (snapshotT2InProgress, browseTree, setupSuggest) for drag-during-sse and project-wizard tests.

nodes.name: projects
nodes.summary: Maps registry rows into the /api/projects DTO shape (id, name, path, project, feature_count, awaiting_count, optional group) so the mock server can answer the projects list endpoint with deterministic data.

nodes.name: initialState
nodes.summary: Returns a fresh StateDTO each call with project p1, two agents (claude-opus = orchestrator+reviewer, opencode = worker) and one feature f1 containing two tasks (t1 in_progress, t2 assigned deps=[t1]). The fixture is deliberately un-aliased so the mock server can mutate its working copy via /__test/snapshot.

nodes.name: browseTree
nodes.summary: Builds the /api/fs/browse tree used by the project wizard e2e: root, /tmp, and three children (/tmp/p1 git+pact, /tmp/new git without pact, /tmp/existing git+pact not pre-registered) with isGit and hasPact flags per entry.
